strategy_1.name: higher precision
strategy_1.candidate: I support the strategy with narrower spatial coverage and higher measurement precision.
arguments: This strategy provides more precise measurements at each observed location.
This strategy reduces measurement uncertainty at the locations that are observed.
This strategy concentrates sensing resources on fewer locations.
This strategy prioritizes measurement precision over spatial coverage.
This strategy uses sensing capacity to improve precision at selected locations.
This strategy accepts narrower coverage in order to obtain more precise measurements.

strategy_2.name: broader coverage
strategy_2.candidate: I support the strategy with broader spatial coverage and lower measurement precision.
arguments: This strategy observes a larger portion of the environment.
This strategy reduces the number of locations that remain unobserved.
This strategy distributes sensing resources across more locations.
This strategy prioritizes spatial coverage over measurement precision.
This strategy uses sensing capacity to monitor a broader area.
This strategy accepts lower precision in order to observe more locations.

strategy_1.priority: Your role prioritizes measurement precision over spatial coverage. This priority should inform your assessment throughout the discussion, but you may still maintain or revise your position based on the information available in the scenario and discussion.

strategy_2.priority: Your role prioritizes broader spatial coverage over measurement precision. This priority should inform your assessment throughout the discussion, but you may still maintain or revise your position based on the information available in the scenario and discussion.
